en: Black‑and‑white / sepia postcard view of a late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century town with a railway overpass and underpass in the foreground, showing multiple tracks on an elevated bridge above a road tunnel. On the right stands a large, ornate multi‑storey building labeled as the post office, with other townhouses and commercial buildings around it. In the background are low hills with terraced vineyards and scattered houses. Printed captions at the top and bottom identify the place as Kötzschenbroda, showing the post office (K. Postamt) and the hill Friedensburg.
